repo_notes.content: grainulation is the umbrella repository and marketing site for the grainulation ecosystem. It is NOT a standalone tool — it is the landing page (grainulation.app), the meta-package that lets users discover the individual packages (barn, wheat, farmer, mill, silo, harvest, orchard), and the place where cross-cutting docs and demos live. The actual functionality lives in the individual packages.
repo_notes.author: grainulation-core

repo_notes.content: When documenting grainulation, emphasize: (1) it is the ENTRY POINT — start here if you're new, (2) it hosts the interactive demo (sprint-mode demo at grainulation.app), (3) each ecosystem package has its own wiki — link out, do not duplicate, (4) grainulation's own site uses PNG favicons (favicon-16.png, favicon-32.png, apple-touch-icon.png) and is intentionally different from the SVG-favicon convention used by the other 7 packages.
repo_notes.author: grainulation-core

pages.title: Quick start
pages.purpose: The 30-second ecosystem pitch, which individual package to install first based on what the user wants (research sprint -> wheat, approvals -> farmer, export -> mill, packs -> silo, analytics -> harvest, portfolio -> orchard, utilities -> barn), and a link to grainulation.app for the interactive demo.

pages.title: Core concepts
pages.purpose: The ecosystem philosophy (zero-dep, research-first, human-in-the-loop), the shape of a research sprint (claims -> compiler -> artifacts), how the packages compose, the role of each package at a glance.

pages.title: API reference
pages.purpose: The meta-package CLI surface (what `npx @grainulation/grainulation` does), links to each package's API reference, site-asset conventions (favicons, sitemap, llms.txt).

pages.title: Ecosystem integration
pages.purpose: The canonical map of how barn, wheat, farmer, mill, silo, harvest, orchard fit together — dependency directions, data flow, typical user journeys from install to published brief. This is the ecosystem overview that all the individual package wikis link back to.
